notes: Tier+Tactical Dualies skins: Akimbo versions of the Pistol skins on Tier 1's Akimbo Pistol. Each holds twice its pistol's magazine (Kai's `TT_maxAmmo*2`), and the onFireAkimbo state pulls the left gun's trigger. Kai left the Covert dualies' file out of the Add-On's server.cs, so they are not loaded.

handles.AkimboClassicPistolImage::onUnMount: engine: the left gun (its left_image) leaves the hand with the right one
handles.AkimboModernPistolImage::onUnMount: engine: the left gun (its left_image) leaves the hand with the right one
handles.AkimboSilencedPistolImage::onUnMount: engine: the left gun (its left_image) leaves the hand with the right one
handles.AkimboSilencedPistolImage::onLoadCheck: never runs: the Akimbo Pistol's states it inherits name TT_onLoadCheck, not onLoadCheck, so v20 never called it
